## Executive Summary
Nimbus Pro is recommended for mid-size and larger teams needing governance controls.

## Product Comparison
Nimbus Core suits small teams of 2-15 people [product-a]. Nimbus Pro targets organizations above 200 employees with RBAC and SSO [product-b].

## Pricing
Nimbus Core costs $9/seat/month with no minimum [pricing]. Nimbus Pro costs $34/seat/month billed annually with a 50-seat minimum [pricing].

## Security
Nimbus Pro offers stronger governance and compliance posture for regulated teams.

## Recommendation
We recommend Nimbus Pro for teams requiring governance and compliance controls.
